supervisor.value: Applicants to the Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Cognitive Science must check the department website for academic advisors and write the name of an intended advisor in the application and study plan.
supervisor.quote: Check the website "http://cogsci.yonsei.ac.kr" for | academic advisors and write the name of an intended | Cognitive Science ○ ○ ○ advisor down in the application and study plan

funding.value: Full-time international students in non-Medical/Dental/Nursing Graduate School departments automatically receive the Yonsei International Companion Scholarship (KRW 3,000,000/semester for 4 semesters in Ph.D.; KRW 2,000,000/semester for 6 semesters in Integrated M.S.-Ph.D.) unless receiving a full-tuition scholarship; full-tuition Graduate Student Assistantships, Yonsei Graduate Fellowships (up to KRW 7,500,000), and GKS scholarships are competitive.

entry_route.value: Yonsei University Graduate School offers both the Integrated Master's-Ph.D. Program (open to applicants holding a Bachelor's degree) and the Ph.D. Program (open to applicants holding a Master's degree) in this department.
entry_route.quote: 1. Eligibility for All Applicants | Master / Integrated Ph. D | w Someone who (will) be awarded a Bachelor’s Degree w Someone who (will) be awarded a Master’s Degree | Cognitive Science ○ ○ ○ advisor down in the application and study plan

notes: Cognitive Science accepts TOPIK Level 3, TOEFL iBT 3.5 (59), or IELTS 5.5, and requires naming an intended advisor in the application and study plan. Neuroscience is also offered via the Brain and Cognitive Sciences track in Medical Sciences (BK21 Project).
